text:
🚨🇵🇱🇬🇧 BREAKING:

TWO passenger planes have received BOMB THREATS while flying to Warsaw, Poland...

A LOT Polish Airlines Boeing 737 MAX 8 operating flight LO286 from London Heathrow was diverted to Warsaw-Modlin Airport.

All 181 people on board were being evacuated as security services investigated the threat.

Modlin Airport was closed until further notice.

Meanwhile, a second bomb threat was reported aboard an SAS flight from Copenhagen to Warsaw.

That aircraft landed at Warsaw-Chopin Airport, where security checks were underway. The airport continued operating.

Both aircraft landed safely, and no explosives have been confirmed.

Source: Reuters, Flightradar24 / Writer: Samuel
